title: Boolean solutions of a quadratic system
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $L$ be a finite list of homogeneous quadratic equations in $n$ variables over the field with two elements, and let $w$ be a Boolean vector of length $n$. Then $w$ satisfies the system when its image under the Boolean-to-field coordinate map satisfies every equation in $L$.
